_comment: Sender-grouping configuration, read by sender_groups.py and passed on to
inbox_summary.py. Everything here is optional -- the pipeline runs with an
empty config, this file only improves how sending identities are merged.
domain_aliases:    registrable domain -> parent brand. For dedicated bulk-mail
domains that belong to exactly one brand, so that a service's
account mail and its marketing mail land on the same row.
split_per_address: shared platforms where one registrable domain fronts many
unrelated senders (mass-mail platforms, free webmail). Each
sending address becomes its own group instead.
address_brand:     one sending address on a shared platform, pinned to the brand
it really belongs to. Overrides split_per_address.
